question: Which English monarch granted the Royal Charter to the East India Company on December 31, 1600?
explanation: On December 31, 1600, Queen Elizabeth I granted a Royal Charter to 'The Governor and Company of Merchants of London trading into the East Indies', marking the official birth of the English East India Company.

question: For how many years was the trade monopoly in the East Indies initially granted to the East India Company by the Charter of 1600?
explanation: The Royal Charter of 1600 initially granted the East India Company an exclusive monopoly on trade with all countries east of the Cape of Good Hope for a period of 15 years.
